confirm.stop.title: Shut down Windows?
confirm.stop.body: Windows shuts down the same way as from its Start menu. Save your work in Windows first.
confirm.reboot.title: Restart Windows?
confirm.reboot.body: Windows restarts the same way as from its Start menu. Save your work in Windows first.
confirm.kill.title: Turn off Windows?
confirm.kill.body: Windows turns off immediately, like pulling the plug. Anything you haven't saved in Windows is lost.
confirm.load.title: Go back to “{name}”?
confirm.load.body: Windows returns to exactly how it was at that moment. Anything since then is lost unless you save it first.
